metadata.description: The harness kit — sets up and keeps lean the Claude Code harness of new and existing projects, large ones included — plus the devlog continuity companion. Opinion: under a capable model, the least harness that works wins.

plugins.name: harness
plugins.description: Sets up and keeps lean the Claude Code harness of a project — root CLAUDE.md, settings.json, per-component CLAUDE.md and the project knowledge layer — for new and existing projects, including large multi-component, long-lived codebases. One skill and three templates; no agents, commands or hooks.

plugins.name: devlog
plugins.description: Records significant changes to .claude/devlog/ — the episodic 'what changed and why' continuity layer, one markdown entry per feature/fix/decision, with index+digest regeneration and a SessionStart digest that auto-surfaces recent devlog + active progress. Optional: the harness does not need it — glossary, ADRs, the tracker and git carry a project's continuity.
